userOutcome: Users can sign up, log in, manage their profile, and have secure sessions
scopeSummary: Identity bounded context (internal/identity/): User entity, Credentials value object, Register + Authenticate command handlers, PostgreSQL user repo (pgx v5), JWT access+refresh tokens, bcrypt hashing, rate limiting, domain events (UserRegistered, UserVerified, PasswordChanged). Next.js login/register/profile pages.
risks: Auth is security-critical — must get right from the start
JWT secret management and rotation strategy
readinessReason: Well-understood generic subdomain. DDD research provides Identity context structure, Go architecture research provides middleware and JWT patterns.
handoffSummary: Implement internal/identity/ bounded context: User aggregate, Register + Authenticate command handlers, PostgreSQL user repository, HTTP handlers. JWT middleware in internal/common/auth. Emit UserRegistered domain event. Rate limiting. Next.js auth pages.
